title: Run settlement and reviewed output close
description: Manual copied-receipt proof through public RPC. FARMSLOT_QA_OUTPUT_PROOF_INPUT supplies runSnapshot, taskDir and repo. Includes negative controls, active-worker retention and required persistence before release.

settlement.intent: Prove completion failure stops the pipeline while its worker continues, acknowledgement retains close, and persistence failure preserves ownership. Break both transition paths and require the checks to fail.
